messages:
harper: Heads-up: nightly SAST flagged 4 auto-suppressed findings in billing/service. Two are HIGH and show meta: keystore_lookup=failed. Not comfortable with auto-suppress on high severity.

sec-scan-bot: Automated: 4 findings suppressed by policy noise-filter-1.7 for billing/* (predicate: equivocal-taint && keystore_lookup!=success). Run report: https://scans.internal/5987

dev-ops: We rotated the scanner identity last evening (svc-scan -> svc-scan-adopted) but the scanner agent process probably used the old token during the run. If the keystore lookup fails we sometimes mark taint as noise.

samir: Can someone paste one suppressed entry (redact secrets)?

harper: Paste (redacted):
```
scanner: go-sast
id: BLG-7102
file: billing/charge_builder.go:134
finding: concatenated SQL fragment in fmt.Sprintf -> query
policy: noise-filter-1.7 (auto-suppress)
meta: keystore_lookup=failed request_id=kms-44
```

maya: I pulled KMS audit for request_id=kms-44: 
```
2026-03-21T11:02:19Z KMS Decrypt DENIED principal=svc-scan request_id=kms-44
2026-03-21T11:02:20Z KMS Decrypt ALLOW principal=svc-scan-adopted request_id=kms-45
```

dev-ops: Yup, that matches: token rotation happened ~11:01 UTC, run started ~11:02 and the agent didn't refresh credentials in time.

samir: Given that, we should not auto-suppress HIGH findings when keystore_lookup failed. Two proposals: (A) unsuppress and re-run after fix; (B) change rule to require explicit human-signed evidence to suppress when keystore lookup != success. Thoughts?

harper: Both. Immediate: unsuppress these 4 now and re-run after infra grants confirmed. Longer-term: change noise-filter predicate so keystore failures cause triage tag instead of auto-suppress.

sec-scan-bot: Unsuppress action queued by harper. New scan-run created: 5987654330.

dev-ops: I'll open an RBAC change to ensure svc-scan-adopted has a stable mapping in IAM and that rotation hooks update scanner config before next run. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-iam/pull/2310

maya: Adding KMS audit lines to SEC-LOG-88 and will request unsuppress+retest. Also adding a short mitigation play: when scanner sees repeated keystore_lookup failures it should open an incident and create a one-hour temporary grant for svc-scan-adopted.

sec-scan-bot: Re-run complete (5987654330): BLG-7102 visible. Severity: HIGH. Evidence: unparameterized SQL at charge_builder.go:134.

samir: Good. Harper, can you file a remediation ticket for the code change (parameterized queries + unit test) and request a follow-up security review?

harper: Filing SEC-788 now. Will add test requirement: assert DB call uses parameterized placeholders for charge IDs.

dev-ops: PR #2310 opened, includes IAM binding kms:Decrypt for svc-scan-adopted and a small CI job to verify scanner identity post-rotation. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra-iam/pull/2310

maya: Also requesting a scanner heuristics update: noise-filter-1.7 -> noise-filter-1.8 where suppression predicate excludes any finding with meta.keystore_lookup != success unless suppression is manual + signed-audit-proof. I'll open the heuristics PR.

samir: Please add monitoring: alert if scanner emits >2 keystore_lookup failures in 15 minutes, page infra-oncall. That would have caught this quickly.

harper: Adding a checklist item to the rotation runbook: after SA rotation, run scanner smoke test against a small repo and verify keystore decrypts succeed.

sec-scan-bot: Note: temporary grant action requested by dev-ops (60m). Audit link: https://iam.internal/changes/9082

dev-ops: Temporary grant applied and then revoked after verification window. Confirmed scanner now uses svc-scan-adopted during nightly.

harper: Closing loop: Unsuppressed + re-run done, RBAC PR opened, heuristics PR pending, remediation ticket SEC-788 opened, monitoring alert requested. Will write 1-paragraph incident note in security-ops summarizing cause (rotation propagation lag), impact (4 suppressed findings, 2 HIGH), and remediation.

maya: Thanks team. Quick reminder: never allow auto-suppress for HIGH severity without a human audit proof. :warning:
